expectedText: I would like to have a picnic with my friends near a lake in spring. I will check the weather forecast the night before and again in the morning. I think the day will be warm, but it might be windy. If I see a dark cloud, I will take an umbrella. If it is going to rain, we will use a nearby cafe instead of sitting outside. We will go indoors immediately if we hear thunder or see lightning. I enjoy sunshine, but a little rain will not end our plan. The important thing is to tell everyone both meeting places before they leave home. Then nobody needs to wait in the wrong place.
